title: Free Trial and Multiple Desktops
content:
Hello, I am a new user hoping to take advantage of the 2 week free trial that comes with the monthly subscription. If I decide I don't like Marvelous Designer and cancel before my trial ends, I'm assuming I won't get charged for the first month, correct? Additionally, I travel often between two locations and am hoping to access my account from both of my desktops - is this possible with one subscription?

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/15cda3245bbd47dd9dbbf3dbeedc2e00/images/fe18ebad7059435b9571ad095dc75e1atrial.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: If you cancel your subscription before the trial ends, you won’t be charged. And you can use it on two computers as long as you’re not using it simultaneously. Make sure to close the software on one PC before using it on another!
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify the terms of the 2-week free trial for Marvelous Designer and address user inquiries about account accessibility across multiple devices.

title: Path of Exile 2 - Sculptures
content:
## _Andrey Loktionov shares his journey on the Path of Exile 2 project, detailing how he created sculptures for the main gameplay menu using Marvelous Designer._

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/408715f28ca146a8b65babccbd17d5a1andrew-loktionov-creature-l.jpg)

* * *

# **Interview with Andrey Loktionov |**[**Sculptures in Path of Exile 2**](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/x3qnkE)**| 3D characters and creatures artist**

# **Can you introduce yourself and your background as an artist?**

Hello! My name is Andrey Loktionov and I'm from Ukraine.

My main specialization is a 3D characters and creatures artist for video games and a sculptor for 3D printing. My experience in the CG is about 14 years. I work in different styles, but my favorite style is dark fantasy and realism.

You can see my works in more detail [here](https://www.artstation.com/loktionov). 

# **Let’s talk about your recent project, “POE2(Path of Exile 2)”. Can you tell us where you got the inspiration for the concept or what was the visual style you were aiming for?**

Well, it’s a great project - an action/RPG game from Grinding Gear Games and I was lucky enough to take part in it a little. My task was to make some statues for the main game menu. This is exactly the dark fantasy style. It’s hard to single out something for inspiration now because there are so many reasons for this.

But if we talk about creating clothes, then Leonardo da Vinci’s Drapery Sketches always comes to mind, where he singles it out in a separate direction, like the anatomy of folds.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/47eec46272d0424898cfc580724fe5b21634711035_4-flomaster-club-p-drapirovki-leonardo-da-vinchi-nabroski-kra-5.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/984d99b2348241b180344f86bde020271634711051_27-flomaster-club-p-drapirovki-leonardo-da-vinchi-nabroski-kra-29.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/10bae2bfeaa64d92b205f80cf637bd981634711061_23-flomaster-club-p-drapirovki-leonardo-da-vinchi-nabroski-kra-25.jpg)

# **How did you use Marvelous Designer in the artwork?**

In this particular project, my main goal was to get a base for the draping of the clothes with further detailing and refinements in ZBrush. To get the dynamics, shape, and of course the base of the folds through simulation.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/c04e1df882b94c17b855a1d4dc76a24dSt_sm_01_06.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/1e3fe3d669954e00be1020b390b8d155St_sm_01_05.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/336295dd1368439bbad321ed7b8ea45bSt_sm_01_04.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/f3cef84c01f1430690108587aa6b602aSt_sm_01_03.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/dd9423a56bdb47b5a7bc72e6a6ecaa78andrew-loktionov-st-sm-01.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/a60caad5715846ba887cf2ac88dd4088andrew-loktionov-st-sm-02.jpg)

# **Why did you decide to use Marvelous Designer? How did it help you serve art direction?**

I have been using Marvelous Designer for many years for different projects. 

In the CG industry, it has long become the main tool and standard for creating clothes of any complexity. Therefore, I can only wish the team to continue to be a leader and be true to their ideas.

# **Can you give us a quick overview of the different tools used in your pipeline?**

Marvelous Designer has a lot of useful tools for creating a cut and setting up fabric simulation.

Each artist can create their own unique pipeline based on the available tools.

Very often I use the morphing method after the basic sewing of clothes in a t pose is done. This is very useful where the character's pose is used in dynamics, for example for 3D printing.

To convey dynamics, the also comes to the Wind Controller. Recently, I have also been using the creation of a cut directly from the avatar through the spline line tool, which speeds up the process.

One way or another, I am constantly finding something new for myself))

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/693161d18850404b82f269a0f4744456St_L_01.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/609d219b661c455e84ed369d4efeaeebSt_L_02.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/9eb99459ca614108984445bda2054d8eSt_L_02_01.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/162919a94eb2478d8a76a91c7a2d391bandrew-loktionov-creature-l.jpg)

# **Do you have any other projects that you have worked on using Marvelous Designer that you can share with us?**

I’m currently using Marvelous Designer to create more advanced cloth outfits for projects that have not yet been announced. I think they will be featured in my portfolio in the near future.

# **How can you describe your overall experience of the use of the Marvelous Designer?**

When creating clothes, it is very important to always remember to use the correct cut and patterns according to the templates, this is the basis for correct further modeling. After all, all processes are as close to real life as possible, and in reality, without this, the suit will not fit well and correctly. In the process of work, do not forget to use as many references as possible and just what is at hand. This will help to give a clearer idea of ​​​​the types of fabric and their properties. The rest is a matter of practice)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/ab244a61591d4800a19bfe1e12116f4eSt_R_01.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/e672d0886c984deab49a4cc0d77ff204St_R_02.jpg)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/1da83034ea744136a6811045337771aa/images/0cab119c5a964b6688f1f6deeaf9758candrew-loktionov-creature-r.jpg)
content_description: Explore Andrey Loktionov's artistic journey in creating stunning sculptures for the Path of Exile 2 gameplay menu, utilizing Marvelous Designer to bring dark fantasy elements to life.

title: Funnel neckline shirt
content:
"This is my second post as a CONNECT supporter for CLO SET CONNECT! In this video, I showcase my workflow for creating a cotton jersey shirt with a funnel neckline in CLO 3D. I used tools like 'Pen on Garment' and 'Pen on Avatar' to shape and refine the design directly in 3D. Watch the full process on YouTube and discover new techniques to enhance your creations!"

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/389be5752da449e29919500a0f4ada49/images/162d14936da745159240bd6a3936ecb5doll_56.png)

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ta-_Y8Py_s4

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Your tutorial is fantastic! The approach is straightforward, and it's an excellent guide that's easy to understand. I think many users will find your tutorial helpful and will benefit from it. Thank you for sharing!💞
Reply 1: So sweet thank you. your comments encourage me to make more and more tutorials.

Comment 2: That’s seriously cool! Wish I could do this, but I can’t. Because I, with my years of training as a patterns cutter and then working as a bespoke tailor, am simply unable to create garments using Pen tool. First, because for me there must be a technical basis to build a garment upon. What I mean is a “basic, professionally drafted pattern”. Second, because I view Clo3D as a pattern prototyping tool rather than a 3D garment creating app. And last, but not least: because I always consider real life’s practical and comfort aspects of the garments I design.Would you consider using for your amazing creations one of the patterns I sell? I would provide it free of charge. And I would be honoured.
Reply 1: Thanks for your comment. Your job is valuable and that is what i always say to the fashion students," perfect visual does not mean perfect fit "so i encourage them to learn at least the essential basic knowledge of drawing patterns and therefore CLO has efficient tools in 2d window.I appreciate your offer and i will keep it in my mind and again thanks for your time and comment.
content_description: Explore my latest video as a CONNECT supporter for CLO 3D, where I demonstrate my workflow for creating a stylish cotton jersey shirt with a funnel neckline, sharing innovative techniques to elevate your design skills.
